//: The models the Whisper helper runs on, pinned. build.sh fetches every entry with "bundled": true into dist/models/ for packaging and refuses any whose size or sha256 differs; the others are for the Speech-to-Text extension to download on request, against the same pins. Each URL names a Hugging Face commit rather than `main`, so a file replaced upstream cannot change what a build ships or what a user downloads. base and small are whisper.cpp's own ggml conversions of OpenAI's multilingual models, quantised to q5_1; vad is Silero VAD v6.2.0 converted by ggml-org for whisper.cpp's whisper_vad_* API (models/download-vad-model.sh in the whisper.cpp tree names the same file). small is not bundled: at 190 MB it would triple the download for everyone, and base keeps up on any machine with AVX2 (measured 1.1 s for a 10 s utterance on 4 threads, small three to four times that).
